C0781.title: GitHub Employee Device Compromise Leads to Code Repository Data Leak
C0781.summary: In May 2026, GitHub said it was investigating TeamPCP's claim that it was selling GitHub source code and internal organization data. The Hacker News reported that GitHub later said it had detected and contained a compromised employee device involving a poisoned Visual Studio Code extension and had rotated critical secrets. The claimed data dump was described as containing about 4,000 internal repositories.
